---- MODULE W4Od18m5p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Doors == {"d1", "d2", "d3"}
Fobs == {"f1", "f2", "f3"}
NONE == "none"
MaxCap == 3

VARIABLES state, cap, target, ballots, tally

vars == <<state, cap, target, ballots, tally>>

Unlocked == {d \in Doors : state[d] = "open"}

Init ==
    /\ state = [d \in Doors |-> "locked"]
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ target = NONE
    /\ ballots = [f \in Fobs |-> NONE]
    /\ tally = 0

Propose(d) ==
    /\ target = NONE
    /\ state[d] = "locked"
    /\ target' = d
    /\ ballots' = [f \in Fobs |-> NONE]
    /\ tally' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<state, cap>>

Vote(f) ==
    /\ target # NONE
    /\ ballots[f] = NONE
    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![f] = "yes"]
    /\ tally' = tally + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<state, cap, target>>

Apply ==
    /\ target # NONE
    /\ tally * 2 > Cardinality(Fobs)
    /\ Cardinality(Unlocked) < cap
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![target] = "open"]
    /\ target' = NONE
    /\ ballots' = [f \in Fobs |-> NONE]
    /\ tally' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

Abandon ==
    /\ target # NONE
    /\ tally * 2 <= Cardinality(Fobs)
    /\ (\A f \in Fobs : ballots[f] # NONE) \/ (Cardinality(Unlocked) >= cap)
    /\ target' = NONE
    /\ ballots' = [f \in Fobs |-> NONE]
    /\ tally' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<state, cap>>

Relock(d) ==
    /\ state[d] = "open"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![d] = "locked"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, target, ballots, tally>>

ChangeCap(n) ==
    /\ n >= Cardinality(Unlocked)
    /\ n <= MaxCap
    /\ cap' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<state, target, ballots, tally>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Doors : Propose(d)
    \/ \E f \in Fobs : Vote(f)
    \/ Apply
    \/ Abandon
    \/ \E d \in Doors : Relock(d)
    \/ \E n \in 0..MaxCap : ChangeCap(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ state \in [Doors -> {"locked", "open"}]
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ target \in Doors \cup {NONE}
    /\ ballots \in [Fobs -> {"yes", NONE}]
    /\ tally \in 0..Cardinality(Fobs)

CapacityRespected ==
    Cardinality(Unlocked) <= cap

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network guards a set of interior doors. At any moment only
a bounded number of doors may be held unlocked at once; that bound is the network's
current "open capacity". Unlocking a door is not unilateral: a controller first
proposes to unlock a specific locked door, then the household key-fobs vote on the
proposal. Only when a quorum (a strict majority of fobs) has voted yes is the unlock
applied and the door counted against capacity. A proposal that fails to reach quorum
is abandoned. An unlocked door can be relocked at any time, freeing one unit of
capacity. Separately, the administrator can change the open capacity at runtime
(for example widening it during a party or tightening it at night), but the network
refuses to lower the capacity below the number of doors already unlocked.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of doors currently unlocked never exceeds the current open capacity.

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ admitted = 0
    /\ printed = FALSE
    /\ printEpoch = NONE
    /\ clearing = NONE

Reconfigure(n) ==
    /\ printed = FALSE
    /\ epoch < 3
    /\ n >= admitted
    /\ n <= MaxCap
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ cap' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<admitted, printed, printEpoch, clearing>>

Admit ==
    /\ printed = FALSE
    /\ admitted < cap
    /\ admitted' = admitted + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, printed, printEpoch, clearing>>

Withdraw ==
    /\ printed = FALSE
    /\ admitted > 0
    /\ admitted' = admitted - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, printed, printEpoch, clearing>>

Print(p) ==
    /\ printed = FALSE
    /\ admitted > 0
    /\ printed' = TRUE
    /\ clearing' = p
    /\ printEpoch' = epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, admitted>>

Idle ==
    /\ (printed \/ epoch >= 3)
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in 0..MaxCap : Reconfigure(n)
    \/ Admit
    \/ Withdraw
    \/ \E p \in Prices : Print(p)
    \/ Idle

    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ admitted \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ printed \in BOOLEAN

    /\ clearing \in Prices \cup {NONE}

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PrintCoherent
nl:
A stock-exchange opening auction collects orders during a pre-open window and then
"prints" a single opening price that becomes the official open. Printing the open is
irreversible: once the auction has printed, that price is the open and cannot be
reprinted or unwound. Before printing, the auction may be reconfigured any number of
times: each reconfiguration bumps an epoch counter and may change the order-book
capacity at runtime (widening or narrowing how many resting orders are admitted).
Reconfiguration is only permitted while the auction has not yet printed; once printed,
the configuration is frozen. Orders may be admitted during the pre-open window up to
the current capacity. The print action stamps the epoch that was current at the moment
it fired.
SAFETY PROPERTY: If the opening price has been printed, then it is a concrete price stamped with an epoch equal to the current (now frozen) epoch.

---- MODULE W4Od17m2p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Scanners == {"a", "b"}
Chutes == {"c1", "c2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES phase, votes, inbox, target, route, committed

vars == <<phase, votes, inbox, target, route, committed>>

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ votes = [s \in Scanners |-> NONE]
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ target = NONE
    /\ route = NONE
    /\ committed = FALSE

Propose(c) ==
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "aborted"}
    /\ committed = FALSE
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ target' = c
    /\ votes' = [s \in Scanners |-> NONE]
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<route, committed>>

SubmitVote(s, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[s] = NONE
    /\ ~ \E m \in inbox : m.s = s
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[s |-> s, v |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, target, route, committed>>

Deliver(m) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ votes[m.s] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m.s] = m.v]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, target, route, committed>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A s \in Scanners : votes[s] = "yes"
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ route' = target
    /\ committed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, inbox, target>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E s \in Scanners : votes[s] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, inbox, target, route, committed>>

Idle ==
    /\ phase = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Chutes : Propose(c)
    \/ \E s \in Scanners, v \in {"yes", "no"} : SubmitVote(s, v)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Deliver(m)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}
    /\ votes \in [Scanners -> {"yes", "no", NONE}]
    /\ inbox \subseteq [s : Scanners, v : {"yes", "no"}]
    /\ target \in Chutes \cup {NONE}
    /\ route \in Chutes \cup {NONE}
    /\ committed \in BOOLEAN

CommitCoherent ==
    (phase = "committed") =>
        (committed /\ route \in Chutes /\ \A s \in Scanners : votes[s] = "yes")

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CommitCoherent
nl:
An airport baggage router commits each bag to exactly one outbound chute using a
two-phase commit across the scanner stations that must all agree on the read tag.
A round begins when the coordinator proposes a target chute for the bag; each scanner
then votes yes or no. Scanners can be slow but never fail: a scanner may delay by
leaving its vote sitting in an in-transit buffer before it is delivered, but every
vote eventually arrives. When all scanners have voted yes the router commits, which
irreversibly drops the bag into the proposed chute and marks the routing done. If any
scanner votes no the round aborts and the coordinator may propose a fresh round.
Committing the bag is irreversible and can happen at most once: once committed no new
round may start. A finished-committed router simply idles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the router is in the committed state, the bag has an actual chute recorded and every scanner had voted yes.

EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Stations == {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
Slots == {"g1", "g2"}
NONE == "none"

NextSt == [s1 |-> "s2", s2 |-> "s3", s3 |-> "s1"]

VARIABLES owner, book, holder, transit

vars == <<owner, book, holder, transit>>

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ book = [st \in Stations |-> {}]
    /\ holder = "s1"
    /\ transit = NONE

PassToken ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ transit = NONE
    /\ transit' = NextSt[holder]
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, book>>

DeliverToken ==
    /\ transit # NONE
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ holder' = transit
    /\ transit' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, book>>

Allocate(s) ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = holder]
    /\ book' = [book EXCEPT ![holder] = @ \cup {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, transit>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ owner[s] = holder
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ book' = [book EXCEPT ![holder] = @ \ {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, transit>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ DeliverToken
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Allocate(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Stations \cup {NONE}]
    /\ book \in [Stations -> SUBSET Slots]
    /\ holder \in Stations \cup {NONE}
    /\ transit \in Stations \cup {NONE}

BookConsistent ==
    \A st \in Stations, s \in Slots : (s \in book[st]) => (owner[s] = st)

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BookConsistent
nl:
An airport baggage router grants exclusive access to its outbound slots using a token
ring among the sorter stations. Exactly one token circulates: only the station that
currently holds the token may allocate a free slot to itself, recording the slot in
its private booking set and marking the slot's physical owner. The token is passed
around the ring, but a station can be slow though never failed: when a station passes
the token it goes in-transit and is delivered to the next station only after an
arbitrary (but finite) delay, during which no station holds it. A holder may also
release a slot it owns, clearing both the physical owner and its own booking. The
safety concern is that a slot must never be double-allocated: a station's booking must
always agree with the single physical owner of that slot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every slot that a station has in its booking set is physically owned by exactly that station.

Cranes == {"k1", "k2"}
NONE == "none"
Cap == 2
MaxGen == 2

VARIABLES authGen, queue, inbox, actedGen

vars == <<authGen, queue, inbox, actedGen>>

Init ==
    /\ authGen = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
    /\ queue = 0
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ actedGen = [c \in Cranes |-> -1]

EnqueueWork ==
    /\ queue < Cap
    /\ queue' = queue + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authGen, inbox, actedGen>>

Issue(c) ==
    /\ queue > 0
    /\ queue' = queue - 1
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[crane |-> c, gen |-> authGen[c]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authGen, actedGen>>

Revoke(c) ==
    /\ authGen[c] < MaxGen
    /\ authGen' = [authGen EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, inbox, actedGen>>

Execute(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ m.gen = authGen[m.crane]
    /\ actedGen' = [actedGen EXCEPT ![m.crane] = m.gen]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authGen, queue>>

DropStale(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ m.gen # authGen[m.crane]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authGen, queue, actedGen>>

Next ==
    \/ EnqueueWork
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Issue(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Revoke(c)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Execute(m)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : DropStale(m)

TypeOK ==
    /\ authGen \in [Cranes -> 0..MaxGen]
    /\ queue \in 0..Cap
    /\ inbox \subseteq [crane : Cranes, gen : 0..MaxGen]
    /\ actedGen \in [Cranes -> -1..MaxGen]

NoStaleAction ==
    \A c \in Cranes : (actedGen[c] = -1) \/ (actedGen[c] <= authGen[c])

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleAction
nl:
A container-ship crane yard feeds lift work to its cranes through a bounded work queue
with backpressure: the yard may hold only a limited number of queued work units, and
refuses to enqueue more once that limit is reached. Each crane carries an authorization
generation. When the dispatcher issues a work unit to a crane it stamps the crane's
current authorization generation onto the order and places it on the wire; the wire may
reorder and delay orders freely. A crane's authorization can be renewed, which bumps its
generation and thereby invalidates any older orders still in flight. A crane executes an
order only when the order's stamped generation still matches the crane's current
authorization; it records the generation it acted under. Orders whose generation no
longer matches are recognized as stale and dropped from the wire. The hazard is a crane
acting under a stale (superseded) authorization.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The generation a crane last acted under never exceeds the crane's current authorization generation.

---- MODULE W4Od0m6p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Rooms == {"r1", "r2"}
Surgeons == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"
LeaseLen == 2
Horizon == 4

VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, done, opTime

vars == <<clock, holder, expiry, done, opTime>>

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = [r \in Rooms |-> NONE]
    /\ expiry = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]
    /\ done = [r \in Rooms |-> FALSE]
    /\ opTime = [r \in Rooms |-> -1]

Acquire(r, s) ==
    /\ done[r] = FALSE
    /\ holder[r] = NONE
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![r] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, done, opTime>>

Renew(r) ==
    /\ done[r] = FALSE
    /\ holder[r] # NONE
    /\ clock <= expiry[r]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![r] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, done, opTime>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < Horizon
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, done, opTime>>

Operate(r) ==
    /\ done[r] = FALSE
    /\ holder[r] # NONE
    /\ clock <= expiry[r]
    /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ opTime' = [opTime EXCEPT ![r] = clock]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

Release(r) ==
    /\ done[r] = FALSE
    /\ holder[r] # NONE
    /\ clock > expiry[r]
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, done, opTime>>

Idle ==
    /\ clock >= Horizon
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Rooms, s \in Surgeons : Acquire(r, s)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms : Renew(r)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E r \in Rooms : Operate(r)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms : Release(r)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..Horizon
    /\ holder \in [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {NONE}]
    /\ expiry \in [Rooms -> 0..(Horizon + LeaseLen)]
    /\ done \in [Rooms -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ opTime \in [Rooms -> -1..Horizon]

OperateWithinLease ==
    \A r \in Rooms : done[r] => (opTime[r] <= expiry[r])

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OperateWithinLease
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler grants each surgeon a time-boxed lease on an
operating room. A lease is acquired against a shared logical clock and carries an
expiry equal to the acquisition time plus a fixed lease length. Time advances by ticks;
a lease holder can be slow but never fails, so the clock may move on while the holder
works, and a holder may renew the lease (pushing the expiry forward) as long as the
lease has not already expired. The irreversible action is performing the operation in a
room, which may happen at most once per room: it is permitted only while the holder's
lease is still valid (the clock has not passed expiry), and it stamps the time it was
performed and closes the case. Once a room's case is operated it is frozen: it can no
longer be acquired, renewed, or released. An unoperated room whose lease has expired can
be released, freeing it for a new lease. When the clock reaches its horizon the
scheduler idles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every room whose operation has been performed, the recorded operation time does not exceed that room's lease expiry.

EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Bays == {"b1", "b2", "b3"}
Dispatchers == {"A", "B"}
NONE == "none"
LeaseLen == 2
Horizon == 3

VARIABLES pool, holder, expiry, sealed, clock

vars == <<pool, holder, expiry, sealed, clock>>

Init ==
    /\ pool = Bays
    /\ holder = [b \in Bays |-> NONE]
    /\ expiry = [b \in Bays |-> 0]
    /\ sealed = {}
    /\ clock = 0

Acquire(b, d) ==
    /\ b \in pool
    /\ pool' = pool \ {b}
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![b] = d]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![b] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<sealed, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < Horizon
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, holder, expiry, sealed>>

Seal(b) ==
    /\ holder[b] # NONE
    /\ clock <= expiry[b]
    /\ b \notin sealed
    /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, holder, expiry, clock>>

ReleaseExpired(b) ==
    /\ holder[b] # NONE
    /\ clock > expiry[b]
    /\ b \notin sealed
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<sealed, clock>>

Idle ==
    /\ clock >= Horizon
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bays, d \in Dispatchers : Acquire(b, d)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Seal(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : ReleaseExpired(b)
    \/ Idle

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \subseteq Bays
    /\ holder \in [Bays -> Dispatchers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ expiry \in [Bays -> 0..(Horizon + LeaseLen)]
    /\ sealed \subseteq Bays
    /\ clock \in 0..Horizon

SealedAreLeased ==
    sealed \subseteq {b \in Bays : holder[b] # NONE}

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SealedAreLeased
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet is coordinated by two independent dispatchers, A and B, that
draw from one shared pool of docking bays. A dispatcher acquires a time-boxed lease on
a free bay: the bay leaves the shared pool, is recorded as owned by that dispatcher, and
gets an expiry equal to the current clock plus a fixed lease length. Because both
dispatchers pull from the same pool, a bay in use is never available to the other. Time
advances by ticks. While a lease is still valid (the clock has not passed expiry), the
owning dispatcher may seal the bay, an irreversible commit of a robot into that dock
that can happen at most once per bay. A sealed bay is frozen and is never returned to the
pool. If a lease expires before the bay was sealed, the bay is released back into the
shared pool for reuse. When the clock reaches its horizon the fleet idles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every sealed bay is currently held under a lease (no sealed bay has been returned to the free pool).

nl:
A stock-exchange opening auction rests incoming orders in an order book whose depth is
capped. Orders flow through a bounded work queue with backpressure. A trader submits an
order, which lands in an in-transit buffer; traders can be slow but do not fail, so a
submitted order may sit in the buffer before it is admitted. The matching engine admits
a buffered order into the resting book only while the book is below its capacity; if the
book is already at capacity, backpressure kicks in and the buffered order is rejected
rather than admitted. A resting order can later be matched or cancelled, in either case
leaving the book. Rejected, matched, and cancelled orders are all considered settled and
do not return. When the buffer and book are both empty the auction idles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of orders resting in the book never exceeds the book capacity.

Cabinets == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
MaxEpoch == 3
MaxStock == 2

vars == <<configEpoch, granted, acted, pendRevoke, stock>>

Init ==
    /\ configEpoch = 0
    /\ granted = {}
    /\ acted = {}
    /\ pendRevoke = {}
    /\ stock = 1

Grant(c) ==
    /\ configEpoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ c \notin granted
    /\ configEpoch' = configEpoch + 1
    /\ granted' = granted \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<acted, pendRevoke, stock>>

RevokeNotice(c) ==
    /\ c \in granted
    /\ c \notin pendRevoke
    /\ pendRevoke' = pendRevoke \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<configEpoch, granted, acted, stock>>

ApplyRevoke(c) ==
    /\ c \in pendRevoke
    /\ granted' = granted \ {c}
    /\ acted' = acted \ {c}
    /\ pendRevoke' = pendRevoke \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<configEpoch, stock>>

Dispense(c) ==
    /\ c \in granted
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ acted' = acted \cup {c}
